instruction: A diving kingfisher rendered as a leaded stained-glass ornament, wings swept back into a teardrop silhouette. Cobalt, turquoise and burnt-orange glass segments are bounded by dark lead came, with a milky white throat patch and a single black glass eye bead. Backlight makes the colored panes glow while the lead lines stay opaque and graphic.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Stained-Glass Kingfisher in a stained-glass style. A diving kingfisher rendered as a leaded stained-glass ornament, wings swept back into a teardrop silhouette. Cobalt, turquoise and burnt-orange glass segments are bounded by dark lead came, with a milky white throat patch and a single black glass eye bead. Backlight makes the colored panes glow while the lead lines stay opaque and graphic. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
